REPORT ON Meeting at No. 27 Elgin Road.
Made by J.W.Prince D.S.I. Forwarded by S. J. Dunn.

Sir,

I beg to report that between 5.45 p.m. and 8.05 p.m.
today a meeting of a Chinese Society called Koh-Ming-Da-Wei-
Tshak-Tsing-Wei 國民大會策進會 was held in the Chinese
Cotton Yarn Guild house No. 27 Elgin Road. There were 189
persons present, 165 of these are members of the Society and
the remaining 24 were guests.

The society, it is reported, generally hold their meetings
in the Cantonese Guild house, Ningpo Road, but for better
accommodation the use of the Hall at 27 Elgin Road was obtained
today.

The chairman at this meeting was one Zau Moo Kwei 曹慕管
a school teacher at the Ching Chong School, Chaufoong Road.

This society was formed on the 21-8-'20 and it is reported
that its members are all in sympathy with the views of the
?? Chinese General Wu Pei Fu 吳佩孚 who is under Tsao Kun, 曹錕
H Tuchun of Chihli. This is evidently a political society.

Since this society was formed members of 107 various guilds
in Shanghai and other parts of China have joined it and it has
a membership of 296 persons, and it is known throughout China.
The chairman of this meeting read out the minutes of the
previous meetings and they were passed. He then made reference
to 542 letters and telegrams, which had been received from
people in different parts of China, who sent congratulations,
and greetings, to the organisers and members of the society
in Shanghai.

So far as could be learned the business before the meeting

1920年8月7日。
关于埃尔金路27号会议的报告。
由副巡长 J.W. Prince 撰写。由 S. J. Dunn 转呈。

先生，

谨报告，今日下午5时45分至8时05分之间，一个名为“國民大會策進會”的中国社团在埃尔金路27号中国棉纱业公会会所举行会议。出席者共189人，其中165人为该会会员，其余24人为宾客。

据报，该社团通常宁波路的广东公会会所举行会议，但为了获得更好的场地，今日使用了埃尔金路27号的礼堂。

本次会议主席为曹慕管（Zau Moo Kwei），系兆丰路（Chaufoong Road）景钟学校（Ching Chong School）的一名教师。

该社团成立于1920年8月21日，据报其成员均同情直系督军曹锟麾下之中国将军吴佩孚的观点。这显然是一个政治性社团。

自该社团成立以来，上海及中国其他地区的107个各类公会已加入其中，现有会员296人，闻名全国。会议主席宣读了前几次会议的纪要，并获得通过。随后，他提及收到了来自中国各地人士发来的542封信件和电报，这些人向该社在上海的组织者和成员表示祝贺与问候。

Resolution proposed by the Street Unions of
the Northern and Eastern Districts of Shanghai City.

Resolved that another election shall be held
for the purpose of adding to the present Committee,
members to be elected from amongst representatives
of those societies or unions which joined the
Organization after the first election.

Reason : At the inauguration of this Organiza-
tion, only about 80 societies or unions joined the
Organization, representatives from which have
been entitled to the privilege of voting and being
elected as members of Committee. Since its
inauguration, the Organization has been rapidly
increasing in members, and it is not fair that
those who joined lately should be deprived of
the privilege of being elected as officers.
Therefore, the best solution is to hold another
election for additional members of Committee
from among the societies or unions which have
joined lately.

编号 2836
日期 1920年9月9日

译文。

上海市北区和东区街道公会提出的决议。

决议举行另一次选举，目的是在现有委员会中增补成员，新成员将从第一次选举后加入本组织的那些社团或公会的代表中选出。

理由：在本组织成立之初，只有约80个社团或公会加入，其代表享有投票权和被选为委员的特权。自成立以来，本组织成员迅速增加，若剥夺近期加入者的被选为官吏的特权，实不公平。因此，最佳解决方案是从近期加入的社团或公会中再举行一次选举，以增补委员会成员。

M a / a .

AM

Rough translation of the Revised Regulations of
the Association for the Establishment of the
National Citizens' Convention.

Chapter I.
Art. 1 - Name - Association for the establishment of
the National Citizens' Convention.
Art. 2 - Object - In a frank and public manner, the
Association, all the members of which belong
to solely people's organizations, will
express their opinions or views in connection
with the Citizens' Convention, so that the
latter may be formed on the opinions or views
of a majority of the people.
Chapter II.
Art. 3 - Organization- The Association is organized by
citizens belonging purely to agricultural,
labour, commercial and educational institutions.
Art. 4 - Condition of joining - Any organization which
desires to join this Association should send
a formal application bearing the chop of the
applicant and will then be admitted as soon
as the application is passed by the "Consulting
Committee" at a meeting.
Chapter III
Art. 5 - Membership and meetings - The institutions
which have joined should send one to three
delegates as representatives, and the latter
will be admitted as members as soon as they
are passed by the Consulting Committee at a
meeting. The members shall have the right
of making speeches, explaining their views,
and voting on resolutions, but they shall all
observe the decisions passed at any meetings.

《国民大会策进会》修订章程粗略译文。

第一章。
第一条 - 名称 - 国民大会策进会。
第二条 - 宗旨 - 本会成员纯属民众团体，将以坦率公开的方式，表达与国民大会有关的意见或观点，以便国民大会能依据大多数人的意见或观点而成立。
第二章。
第三条 - 组织 - 本会由纯粹属于农业、劳工、商业和教育机构的公民组织而成。
第四条 - 入会条件 - 任何希望加入本会的组织应提交盖有申请人印章的正式申请，一经“咨询委员会”在会议上审议通过，即予接纳。
第三章
第五条 - 会员与会议 - 已加入的机构应派遣一至三名代表作为 delegate，后者一经咨询委员会在会议上审议通过，即被接纳为会员。会员享有发言、阐述观点和表决决议的权利，但均须遵守任何会议上通过的决定。

第八条 - 职员及其权利 -
(a) 已加入的协会应从其代表中选举一人担任咨询委员会委员。其权利如下：
(1)- 出席咨询委员会会议，并对提交其决定的决议进行表决。
(2)- 调查已加入的协会或其代表，并决定其是否具备资格。
(3)- 监督执行委员会执行会议决定的情况。
(4) 咨询委员会的权利仅在会议通过的事项中得到承认。其个人行动不予承认。
(b) 执行委员会 - 其成员由已加入的机构选举产生。其职责为：
(1)- 总办事处，负责处理不属于以下各部门管辖的所有事务。
(2)- 秘书处，负责所有信件、会议记录和出版物。
(3)- 财务部，负责收支款项。

(4)- Social Department - In charge of affairs
concerning entertaining or communicating with
other parties.
(5)- Investigating Department-
    The rights of members of all departments shall
be restricted viz. only to carry out the decisions
of the Consulting Committee. In case of internal
matters, the Executive Committee can hold a meeting
and decide steps to be taken. The number of
members of each department, to be decided in accor-
dance with the nature of their work. Each depart-
ment will elect one man in charge.
Chapter V.
Art. 9- Expenses and Meeting place - Expenses will be
divided into 2 :
(a) Ordinary- to be borne by institutions which
have joined.
(b) Special- The raising of same to be decided at
a meeting.
Art. 10- Office of the Association to be in the Cantonese
Guild, Ningpo Road - To be removed when suitable
building is secured.
Chapter VI.
Art. 11- Appendix - The Association is formed as soon as
an inaugurati■e meeting is held and will be
dissolved as soon as the Citizens' Assembly is
convened.
Art. 12- The above regulations to be enforced as soon as
they are passed by a big meeting of the members,
but if one tenth of the members considers advisable,
the regulations will be revised at a meeting to be
arranged.

(4)- 社交部 - 负责招待或与其他方面联络的事务。
(5)- 调查部 -
    各部门成员的权利应受限制，即仅执行咨询委员会的决定。对于内部事务，执行委员会可召开会议并决定采取的步骤。各部门成员人数，根据其工作性质决定。每个部门将选举一人负责。
第五章。
第九条 - 经费与会议地点 - 经费分为两类：
(a) 常规经费 - 由已加入的机构承担。
(b) 特别经费 - 其筹集方式由会议决定。
第十条 - 本会办事处设在宁波路广东公会 - 待找到合适房屋后搬迁。
第六章。
第十一条 - 附录 - 本会在召开成立大会后即告成立，并在国民大会召开后即行解散。
第十二条 - 上述规章经会员大会通过后立即生效，但如果十分之一的会员认为适宜，将在安排的会议上对规章进行修订。
